changes.oldText: Superadmins have a Dashboard entry in the administration sidebar, showing a board of system-wide cards: Session Status, Pending Sessions and Reasons, Agents, Agent Statistics, Failures by Entity Type, Audit Log, and Total Resources in Resource Group. More cards, such as Scheduling Failures, Resource Policies, Failed sign-ins, and Container Registries, can be added from the edit sidebar.
changes.newText: Superadmins have a Dashboard entry in the administration sidebar, showing a board of system-wide cards: Session Status, Pending Sessions and Reasons, Agents, Agent Statistics, Failures by Entity Type, Audit Log, Total Resources in Resource Group, Sessions Created, and Folders by Usage Mode. More cards, such as Scheduling Failures, Resource Policies, Failed sign-ins, Container Registries, and Sessions by Status, can be added from the edit sidebar.

changes.oldText: A superadmin can work in the WebUI with another user's permissions. Open the more actions menu in that user's row, select Use as this user, and confirm with Open in new tab.
changes.newText: A superadmin can work in the WebUI with another user's permissions. Open the more actions menu in that user's row, select Use as this user, and confirm with Open in new tab. Check Debug mode in the confirmation dialog to show debugging information, such as raw error details, in that tab.
